parent.title: Epic: Complete beginner-friendly GitHub documentation and module reference
parent.description: Overhaul all Agent Queue documentation for new users with no prior project knowledge. Deliver a coherent hierarchy, practical onboarding, accurate current-behavior guides and exhaustive source-module coverage. Plan: docs/plans/documentation-overhaul/README.md. All child work uses standard-high without pinned profiles. Documentation changes must be delivered through configured AQ integration; no legacy per-task/final-review tickets.

nodes.title: Define beginner documentation hierarchy and complete module coverage inventory
nodes.description:
Audience: new users who know nothing about AQ. Explain purpose and terminology before implementation details; include a realistic example, inputs/outputs, state ownership, common failures/recovery, related pages, source links and focused test references. Describe implemented behavior on current main, distinguishing configured local policy, shipped defaults, optional compatibility and proposed work. Use GitHub-rendered Markdown, relative links and Mermaid where helpful. Never present old review/triage/Discord-control flows as current defaults. Do not change runtime behavior as part of this documentation ticket. Use focused local documentation checks; no full application test suite or repeated CI runs. Follow the foundation ticket's page ownership and navigation contract; write your own module-coverage shard rather than competing over shared indexes. Each production module in your scope must have a named catalog entry with purpose, source path, owning component and documentation link, even when private helpers share a component page. Include nested modules, not just top-level packages. Re-read source when implementing because main is active. Use standard-high without a provider/profile pin.

Scope: All tracked production modules in src/, dashboard/src/, packages/, plus migrations/, scripts/, configuration, shipped prompts and GitHub workflows. Inventory current docs, broken links, duplicate pages and removed features. Planning snapshot is docs/plans/documentation-overhaul/module-inventory.json; refresh it against implementation HEAD.

Deliverables: docs/README.md skeleton; documentation map and page ownership contract; exhaustive module-to-page/child-owner manifest; glossary; style and runnable-example rules. Top-level navigation: Start here → First task → Core concepts → How-to guides → Reference/module catalog → Contributing → Historical material.
acceptance: Every tracked production module has an assigned documentation owner; nested modules and root-level helpers are included, with no unassigned catch-all left unexplained.
Publish a browsable tree and beginner reading order; separate user workflows from contributor internals and historical specs.
Assign distinct page paths and coverage shards to sibling tickets; final navigation assembly owns shared indexes after the foundation.
Record current inaccuracies, including automatic reviewer creation, old triage workflow, Discord control commands and obsolete runtime/migration instructions.
